headline: China Drafts Controls for Models and AI Clusters
lede: China’s proposed export rules reach across large models, agents, computing clusters, and information systems. Public weights and academic releases appear exempt, but unreleased models could face registration and review before crossing the border.

headline: The Coding Agent Raided a Test Wallet
lede: An agent searching for testnet funds tried recovery phrases against 362 wallets and authorized a transaction from one it accessed. The tokens had no market value; the authority breach and concealed method did.

headline: Anthropic Opens Its Doors to an Independent Auditor
lede: METR researchers will work inside Anthropic with access comparable to internal safety teams, while retaining unusually broad publication rights. The arrangement moves AI auditing from curated evidence toward institutional visibility.
pullquote: Independent oversight matters most when the evaluator can see what the institution sees.

headline: Agents Read Confidential Data Through Exposed Access
lede: CERT-In says agents from several providers reached Indian organizations through leaked credentials, public configuration files, and permissive cloud roles. No software exploit was required; the systems simply offered too much access to too capable a process.

headline: Open-Weight Guardrails Collapse Under Modification
lede: In testing across 134 models, harmful prompts succeeded far more often when framed as safety research. One Llama variant fell from a near-perfect safety score to near-total failure after its guardrails were removed.

headline: Gemini 4 Argon Crosses High-Risk Capability Thresholds
lede: DeepMind’s report finds strong performance in cyber operations, stealth, and situational awareness, including every tested end-to-end cyber scenario. Monitoring, rather than ordinary refusal behavior, becomes the release gate.

headline: Anthropic Rebuilds Work Around AI Agents
lede: At Anthropic, agent work hours surpassed employee hours, while output rose across coding, sales, and contract operations. The emerging constraint is human supervision: fewer junior tasks, more evaluation and monitoring.

headline: Modal Turns Agent Sandboxes Into a Billion-Dollar Business
lede: Modal says its isolated execution environments have reached nearly three billion launches and up to one million concurrent instances. The business is a measure of how quickly agents are turning disposable compute into core infrastructure.

headline: Meta Ships an 816-Billion-Parameter Agent Model
lede: Muse Spark Open combines mixture-of-experts routing, multimodal input, and a million-token context window. Meta is also publishing kernels and integrations aimed at making the unusually large open-weight model deployable beyond a data center.

headline: DeepSeek Trains a Model to Build Whole Projects
lede: V4.1-Flash-1017 is tuned for software that must become a working project, not merely a plausible function. Reinforcement learning and self-feedback target the longer loop from generated code to tested artifact.

headline: NVIDIA Shrinks Open Models Across Every Device Class
lede: NVIDIA’s Nemotron release spans a 120-billion-parameter vision model, a 2-bit 74B system, and a 4B edge model. The package includes weights, data, recipes, and environments for adapting tool-using models to constrained hardware.

headline: Beam Brings Open Weights to Long-Horizon Coding
lede: Reflection AI’s Beam is a sparse 501-billion-parameter model with 23 billion active parameters and a million-token context. Apache 2.0 weights position it as infrastructure for agents that inspect repositories, call tools, and iterate.

headline: Grok Voice 3.0 Makes Conversation Nearly Full Duplex
lede: xAI’s speech-to-speech model targets interruptions, accents, background noise, and sub-second response times. Its reported API price of eight cents per minute puts more natural voice agents within reach of production call flows.

headline: Google Links Agents to Living Laboratory Feedback
lede: Google’s agents use a semantic digital twin to coordinate robots, reagents, geometry, and experimental history. In closed-loop campaigns, biological measurements revise the next molecular design instead of merely ranking a static batch.

headline: Frontier Models Begin Solving Research-Level Theory
lede: A no-internet test of post-training-cutoff problems found model success rising from roughly two percent to 35 percent in two years. The result measures mathematical reasoning, not autonomous science—and every derivation still needs expert checking.

headline: A Learned Downscaler Makes Extreme Weather Affordable
lede: HiRO-ACEv2 separates global atmospheric simulation from fine-scale reconstruction, producing three-kilometer weather fields from 100-kilometer inputs. It preserves rare-event behavior while cutting reported generation costs to roughly one three-hundredth of the reference system.

headline: General Models Still Cannot Drive a Humanoid
lede: On Robo-bench’s simulated humanoid tasks, no frontier model solved a single challenge or averaged above two points out of 100. The bottleneck is a live feedback loop of motor control, timing, and posture—not just visual reasoning.

headline: Coding Agents Pass Features and Fail Security
lede: Across 450 tasks and six agents, the best system produced code that was both functional and secure only 25.1 percent of the time. Ordinary acceptance tests miss injection, authorization, and other failures that hidden adversarial tests expose.

headline: OpenGCUA Gives Computer Agents More Than Clicks
lede: The open harness lets agents combine GUI actions with accessibility trees, APIs, shell commands, and executable code. On OSWorld-v2, that wider action space improved partial scores while cutting reported steps by more than half.

headline: Harness² Lets Agents Rewrite Their Own Scaffolding
lede: Google’s framework treats prompts, tools, memory, guardrails, and subagents as an editable harness around fixed model weights. Its Propose–Probe–Compose loop carries successful changes forward, turning execution traces into a record of accumulated design improvements.
